rows.organisme: Inženjerska komora Srbije (national register of licence holders, on behalf of the MGSI ministry)
rows.notes: Since 2019 licences (licencirani arhitekta) have come under the MGSI; the IKS maintains the Registar under an agreement of 28 February 2020. The register holds 30,028 registrants across ALL professions (2021, press), of whom 14,892 active — architects are not broken out publicly, hence the headcount left empty (the ACE’s 2024 estimate is 3,300 architects). Public search by name, no bulk list; nothing on data.gov.rs (API: 0 results). Two domains coexist (ingkomora.rs / ingkomora.org.rs). UIA section via the UAS.

rows.organisme: Licensing by entity: Federalno ministarstvo prostornog uređenja (FBiH); RS ministry; Brčko separate

alternatives.nom: Asocijacija arhitekata u Bosni i Hercegovini (AABH)
Inžinjerska komora FBiH (sans pouvoir de licence)

rows.notes: Competence split between the entities. FBiH: the FMPU publishes a public nominal table of authorised persons — ≈2,157 people, of whom 226 under “Arhitektura” (direct count, August 2026); the headcount shown covers ONLY the Federation. RS: ministerial licences, with no consolidated public list found. The title is not protected as such (activity authorisations). AABH (500+ members, 1995) is an association; BiH is absent from the list of UIA sections. Never add FBiH+RS together without saying so.

rows.organisme: Komora arhitekata i planera Crne Gore

alternatives.nom: Savez arhitekata Crne Gore (SACG, section UIA — site hors ligne)

rows.notes: The 2017 reform and then a new law: the “licencirani arhitekta” must be entered on the chamber’s register (examination + 3 years’ experience). Complete public register on a single HTML page: 758 members as at 5 August 2026, of whom 708 “ARHITEKTA”, 18 landscape architects, 7 planners (direct count); no structured export. Traps: the IKCG survives for engineers; sacg.me dead (522); texts from before and after the reform are contradictory depending on the date. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the 738 published records): 711 architects — the 708 counted only the records reading “ARHITEKTA” in CAPITALS (3 in lower case were missed); + 18 landscape architects and 7 planners in annexes; the “758 members” counter is explained: 738 active + 20 members with suspended membership (a dedicated mirovanje register, zero overlap); the register of 82 foreign members is a filtered view of the main one (82/82 matched); the individual records do not carry a licence number (verified).

rows.organisme: Комора на овластени архитекти и овластени инженери (joint chamber for architects + engineers)

alternatives.nom: Асоцијација на архитектите на Македонија (AAM, section UIA)

rows.notes: Single chamber (Закон за градење, art. 39, founded December 2007): only овластен архитект/инженер may design/review/supervise; membership and entry on the register are compulsory once authorised (EUR 50/year, 5 years). ≈3,200 active authorisations for ≈7,000 members across ALL professions (membership page, undated) — architects not broken out, hence the headcount left empty. The online register requires a member login — no public consultation.

rows.organisme: Ministria e Infrastrukturës dhe Energjisë (individual and company licences for design/supervision)

alternatives.nom: Shoqata e Arkitektëve të Shqipërisë (SHASH, section UIA — site en erreur SSL)

rows.notes: No order in force: the “Urdhri i Arkitektit” bill was still under debate at the end of 2025 (petitions against it). MIE professional licences (through e-Albania); the title is not protected. The Regjistrat page publishes nominal PDFs (including “Individë... studim e projektim”, version of 29 January 2025), but the PDFs sit behind the Incapsula anti-bot — counting impossible, headcount null. Separate lists for individuals/companies and design/supervision; architects are not separated out there as a matter of course.

rows.organisme: Ministria e Mjedisit, Planifikimit Hapësinor dhe Infrastrukturës — regjistri i arkitektëve (entry on the register; professional licence to come with the Oda)

alternatives.nom: Asociacioni i Arkitektëve të Kosovës (AAK, section UIA)

rows.notes: Law 08/L-012 creates chambers (Oda e Arkitektëve), currently being set up — in the meantime licences and the register sit with the ministry (UA 06-08/2023). The register = a complete nominal PDF (38 pp., created 19 September 2023): 1,116 entries counted (1,109 unique e-mails) — counted from the structure, not certified. Traps: the acronym AAK also refers to a political party; check whether the chamber has become operational since; the currency of the PDF is unknown beyond 2023. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the PDF): 1,133 persons (1,135 lines, 2 registrants printed twice; references A/0001-A/1135 continuous); the final Shënim states that entry on the register does NOT confer the Licence Profesionale (the Oda is not yet constituted) and the document contains NO A/B category — the earlier 1,116 “A and B licence holders” cannot be verified from this source.
